response.query: Which behavioral tasks (similarity ratings, forced-choice semantic matching, descriptive labels) should we run to validate semantic content of generated music and produce behavioral RDMs?
response.answer: To validate semantic content of generated music, use similarity ratings and descriptive labels to produce behavioral Representational Distance Matrices (RDMs). Forced-choice semantic matching can also be useful for additional validation.
